policy: Canonical geography entries identify native source geographies first. Cross-year comparability is recorded separately so incompatible geographies are not silently treated as equivalent.

geographies.name: County
geographies.system: Counties, County Boroughs, Rural/Urban Districts, Wards, District Electoral Divisions, Townlands
geographies.notes: Pre-1973 system. In 1973 the system changed to 26 Local Government Districts which were used for 1981, 2001, and 2011 censuses. The 1981 census used the new 26-LGD structure. 1971 and earlier used counties/county boroughs.

2001_to_2011.notes: Same 582 wards and 26 DCs. Direct 1:1 mapping. Same ward codes (95XX##).

2011_to_2021.notes: Complete boundary reorganisation. Need lookup table mapping old 26 DCs to new 11 LGDs (many-to-many in some cases). Old 582 wards to new 462 wards requires spatial intersection or official crosswalk. NISRA may publish a best-fit lookup.

pre1973_to_post1973.notes: 1926-1971 use county/DED system. 1981 onwards uses 26 LGDs. Would need GIS-based spatial crosswalk or published lookup from NISRA. Some DEDs map cleanly to wards but many do not.
